clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper studies what magical corruption does to elves. Concerned by the path taken by the high elves of Quel'Thalas, he examines cursed aquatic and demonic creatures for signs of how corruption changes mind and body.

From Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper looks beyond Darkshore's coastal troubles to the danger he sees in the high elves of Quel'Thalas. He watches with dismay as they embrace perilous arcane practices and call themselves blood elves. Gershala wants to understand the bodily and spiritual changes that follow unchecked magic. To study them, he sends seasoned Alliance adventurers into the submerged halls of Blackfathom Deeps to gather corrupted brain stems from the naga and satyr who dwell there.

Gershala's interest in naga and satyr brain stems comes from their shared past. Both races were once night elves, before they yielded to Queen Azshara and demonic bargains. Gershala examines the marks that millennia of demonic and abyssal energies have left on their nervous systems. He hopes to find warnings or safeguards that might keep other elven kin from suffering similar monstrous deformity.
